item.title: Dad's Daily Digest — 2026-03-01
item.description:
# Episode Summary
This episode covers the geopolitical earthquake following Iran's Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei's assassination—including newly revealed CIA involvement in the Israeli operation and how it disrupts energy markets through potential Strait of Hormuz disruptions—alongside analysis of Berkshire Hathaway's post-Buffett transition under new CEO Gregory Abel, whose corporate communication style signals a genuine shift in the company's era. The episode also examines the rising sophistication of workplace surveillance software and its counterproductive effects on employee trust and retention.
